messages:
rachel: Heads up — downtown is a mess. Water pooling at the 7th St entrance, nearly flooded my shoes. Anyone else seeing crazy puddles?

ben: Yep, my 12 bus took a hard left and we detoured around 7th. Driver said some stops are closed. :bus:  

transit-bot: SERVICE ALERT: 12-FOREST/HARRISON DETOUR due to localized flooding near 7th & Pine. Expect 10-20 min delays. https://sfmuni.example/alerts

alvaro: Caltrain SMS said "temporary speed restriction" between 22nd St and Bayshore. Slow roll this morning.

liz: Ferry was cancel-notify for a bit but resume at 7:40. If you're planning to head out via the ferry, double-check the schedule.

rachel: Office note: lobby mat near the visitor desk is drenched. Please wipe or stash shoes on the rack by the bike room.

ops-bot: FACILITIES: Extra mats placed by the main lobby. Stairwell lights are on for overflow. Maintenance ticket #FLOOD-2201.

maria: I left two pairs of dry socks in the community closet at 10:15, first come. Also someone left a blue compact umbrella by the 2nd-floor railing.

ben: Poll: who wants tomorrow's standup remote if the weather keeps this up? React :house_with_garden: for remote, :office: for in-person.

alvaro: :house_with_garden: leaning remote. Caltrain is unpredictable today.

liz: :office: I'll brave it, but bringing a change of clothes.

rachel: Also PS — if you see a soggy commuter with an orange back pack near the elevator, it's me. I will trade coffee for a towel. :coffee: :towel:
